The '''Moth''' was a truncated [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by the [[Meirm Speeder Emporium]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Meirm Moth was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[November 17]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Force Alliance Pack on the Cartel Market.

==Appearances==
*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
